laws.faithful: Suppose a flow and web have a list at each natural-number step listing exactly the roles with positive levels, and at every step t ≥ T the flow runs down on some list relative to the web. For every role c, not every natural-number N has a step t ≥ N at which c's level is less than its next-step level.
laws.planted: Suppose a flow and web within an environment have a list at each natural-number step listing exactly the roles with positive levels, and at every step t ≥ T the flow runs down on some list relative to the web. For every role c, not every natural-number N has a step t ≥ N at which c's level is less than its next-step level.

laws.faithful: For states with decidable equality, a map from states to states, and a list containing every state, the map's process is lossless if and only if, for every state s, there is no absorbing region into which s is drawn.

laws.faithful: For a web and two histories assigning natural-number levels to every natural-number step and role, if the first includes and exceeds the second in the web, then the second does not both include and exceed the first.

laws.faithful: For a web and three histories assigning natural-number levels to steps and roles, suppose that at every step every feature admitted under the second history is admitted under the first, and every feature admitted under the third is admitted under the second. Then at every step every feature admitted under the third history is admitted under the first.

laws.faithful: In the valuation formed from any web, relation and significance predicate, f is associated with (f, t) at every natural-number step t. The elements associated with f at every step form a relation-closed region containing f, and every relation-closed region containing f contains the first component of every pair associated with f.

The elements associated with f at every step form a relation-closed region containing f, and every relation-closed region containing f contains the first component of every pair associated with f.

laws.faithful: For a frame in which every element–step pair is realized in some state, and any significance predicate, significance holds at every position, natural-number step and element if and only if, for every state and every pair realized there, significance holds at every position for that pair's step and element.

laws.faithful: For any set of indices and two predicates on it, if the first holds at every index, then, for every index, the second holding implies that the first holds.
laws.planted: For any set of indices in a surrounding system and two predicates on it, if the first holds at every index, then, for every index, the second holding implies that the first holds.

laws.faithful: For any list of maps from natural numbers to natural numbers, suppose each map sends every x to a value at least x. For all natural numbers d and n, the value after n iterations of applying the maps in list order, starting at d, is at least d.

laws.faithful: For natural numbers l, d, a, b, x with a > 0, suppose a rule's outputs at t agree whenever records agree at all s with s + l < t. If every record of natural-number pairs with gaps at most d gives a course from x between a and b at every step, then a + (l + 1)(d + d) ≤ b.

laws.faithful: For natural numbers l, d and x with (l + 1)d ≤ x, the delayed reversal rule gives identical outputs at t whenever records agree at every s with s + l < t, and every record with gaps at most d has its course y from x satisfy x ≤ y(t) + (l + 1)d at every step. The remaining bound is truncated.

laws.faithful: Given two flows, a web, a feature–role relation and a Boolean marker, let coupling mean coupling from either flow using that web and relation. For every feature g, some feature h marked true has g in every region closed under reversed coupling containing h if and only if some feature h marked true belongs to every region closed under coupling containing g.

laws.faithful: In a web, let r assign natural numbers to steps and features, never increasing at an unsupported feature and strictly decreasing there whenever the feature is active or r is positive. If f is unsupported at every step t ≥ S and r at S and f is at most n, then f is not active at S + n.

laws.faithful: For a flow, a web and a role c, suppose every feature requires c at some step and, at some possibly different step, is present with a positive amount taken from or given to c. Then, for every pair of features f and g, g belongs to the closure from f under the flow's effect relation in the web.

laws.faithful: For any list and natural-number weight function on its element type, the square of the sum of the listed weights equals the list's length times the sum of the squared listed weights if and only if every two elements belonging to the list have equal weights.

laws.faithful: For a list of maps from natural numbers to natural numbers and natural numbers d and n, if n iterations of applying the maps in list order from d give a value below d, then there is a map g in the list and a natural number x such that g sends x to a value below x.

laws.faithful: For any process, any condition on its runs and any run r, r satisfies the condition if and only if both hold: for every natural-number horizon h there is a run satisfying the condition that agrees with r up to h; and if such a run exists for every h, then r satisfies the condition.

laws.faithful: For any figure consisting of six Boolean lines, there is a Boolean value at each height agreeing with the displayed line in every half if and only if, at every height, the lower and upper lines are not opposed.
laws.planted: For any figure consisting of six Boolean lines, according to a law there is a Boolean value at each height agreeing with the displayed line in every half if and only if, at every height, the lower and upper lines are not opposed.

laws.faithful: Let f update a pair from sets A and B using a value from R, and let h update that value; suppose changing only the B component never changes f's A output or h's output. For every Boolean schedule and two initial configurations agreeing in their A and R components, their paced courses agree in both those components at every natural-number step.

laws.faithful: For natural numbers p, q, k, n, u and v with v ≤ u, the sum of the weights with parameters p and q over Boolean courses generated at depth n with at least k true entries, multiplied by uᵏvⁿ, is at most (pu + qv)ⁿvᵏ.

laws.faithful: With natural-number parameters p, q and n, a Boolean course generated at depth n has weight equal to the product of p for each true entry and q for each false entry, with empty product 1. Then (p + q) times the sum, over these courses, of weight times number of true entries equals np(p + q)ⁿ.

laws.faithful: For the map sending each natural number to its successor, there is an absorbing region into which zero is drawn, and the associated process is lossless.
laws.planted: For the map sending each natural number to its successor, there is an absorbing region within a surrounding system into which zero is drawn, and the associated process is lossless.

laws.faithful: For a map from a state type to itself and a list containing every state, the associated process is lossless if and only if every state returns under that process.
laws.planted: For a map from a state type to itself studied by an analyst and a list containing every state, the associated process is lossless if and only if every state returns under that process.

laws.faithful: The predecessor of zero is zero, and every positive natural number has a strictly smaller predecessor. For all natural numbers d and n with n < d, the value after n predecessor steps starting at d is positive.

laws.faithful: For any element f, position p and significance predicate, there is a region containing f, closed under the empty relation, in which every element is significant at p at every natural-number step if and only if f is significant at p at every natural-number step.

laws.faithful: For a list and Boolean functions a and b, suppose a class contains every strict comparison of weighted totals using positive natural-number weights on the list, and each relation in it relates y to x whenever x includes and exceeds y there. Then a includes and exceeds b there if and only if every relation in the class relates b to a.

laws.faithful: For a flow, a web and a role c, if every feature either depends on c in the web or exchanges with c in the flow, then, for every pair of features f and g, g belongs to the closure from f under the sharing relation determined by that flow and web.

laws.faithful: Suppose a web and a step-indexed relation have this property: every feature active at the next step is either active now or related at the current step from some currently active feature. For every natural-number step t and feature a inactive at t but active at t + 1, there is a feature b active at t and related to a at t.

laws.faithful: For a process and a Boolean gate on actions, suppose a state property propagates backward across every step whose gate is false. If a trace from s to t follows a finite action list and the property holds at t, then it holds at s or the list splits into a prefix reaching m, a gate-true step to r satisfying the property, and a suffix reaching t.

laws.faithful: For a state sequence and an action sequence indexed by natural numbers, there is a process allowing every indicated transition and giving at most one next state for each state–action pair if and only if, for every two indices, equal states and equal actions imply equal next states.
